name: Roy Tillman
source:
Ever-armed with a charming smile and platitudes, it's easy to see why Roy's highly sought after in the world of cinema. Gilda can't help but wonder what he's doing closer to Broadway than Hollywood—or why she's the one within his sights. What's a girl to do when Hollywood's Golden Boy seems to be stuck on her?
